what_it_does: Detects data races in systems where CPUs and GPUs share unified memory (a single address space accessible by both processors). Data races occur when two processors access the same memory location without proper synchronization. Instruments both CPU and GPU code during LLVM compilation, recording all reads, writes, and synchronization events, then analyzes these traces offline to find conflicts. Integrates into AMD's ROCm/HIP compilation toolchain.
